entities.name: Ankh-ef-en-Khonsu i
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ankh-ef-en-Khonsu i, otherwise known as Ankh-af-na-Khonsu, was a priest of the ancient Egyptian god Montu who lived in Thebes during the 25th and 26th Dynasty. He was the son of Bes-en-Mut I and Ta-neshet.
